components.name: Analyze text
components.description: Full-width primary action with a fixed busy-state height.
components.css: .ds-analyze{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Variable',sans-serif;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms ease,color 150ms ease,border-color 150ms ease;justify-content:space-between;background:var(--blue,#244b68);color:var(--paper,#fff);width:100%;height:43px;padding:0 15px;font-size:13px}.ds-analyze>span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}.ds-analyze:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--blue-hover,#183a54)}.ds-analyze:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ochre,#a27624);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-analyze:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-analyze:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.5}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-analyze{transition:none}}

components.name: M1–M5 pipeline rail
components.description: Five ordered links to the actual processing stages.
components.html: M1LexerText → tokensM2Symbol tableTokens → vocabularyM3ParserWords → structureM4FeaturesStructure → signalsM5ScoringSignals → verdict
components.css: .ds-rail{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));border:1px solid var(--line,#e2e6eb);background:#f0f3f6;border-radius:9px;padding:20px 8px;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Variable',sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#233343)}.ds-rail>a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:0;padding:0 13px;text-decoration:none;color:inherit}.ds-rail>a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ochre,#a27624);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-rail-icon{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:34px;height:34px;border:1px solid #dce3e9;background:#f9fafb;border-radius:7px;color:#5f7589;flex-shrink:0}.ds-rail>a:hover .ds-rail-icon{color:var(--blue,#244b68);border-color:#b0c0ce;background:var(--paper,#fff)}.ds-rail-text{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;min-width:0}.ds-rail-text>span:first-child{display:flex;gap:7px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}.ds-rail-text small{font-family:var(--font-mono,'IBM Plex Mono',monospace);font-size:9px;color:var(--muted,#657180);font-weight:400;align-self:center}.ds-rail-text>span:last-child{font-size:9px;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--muted,#657180)}@media(max-width:1280px){.ds-rail{padding:16px 3px}.ds-rail>a{padding-inline:10px;gap:8px}.ds-rail-text>span:last-child{display:none}}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-rail{padding:13px 3px}.ds-rail>a{flex-direction:column;gap:7px;padding-inline:1px}.ds-rail-icon{height:28px;width:28px}.ds-rail-text>span:first-child{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:8px}.ds-rail-text small{font-size:8px}}

narrative.overview:
The interface presents source text beside an inspectable report. Thin borders, cool neutral surfaces, and restrained blue actions keep the pipeline readable during a course demonstration. The M1–M5 rail identifies the actual processing order and links to each stage.

This is a product interface for local use on Windows. The current interface and supported analysis text are English; no market-specific visual or business assumptions are established. Copy uses direct labels and instructions: “Text analysis,” “Analyze text,” “No analysis yet,” and “Model verdict: Human” or “Model verdict: AI.” Avoid promotional or poetic language.
keyCharacteristics: Clear separation between source text, model readiness, and results.
A visible M1–M5 sequence grounded in the real pipeline.
Flat surfaces, thin borders, and limited color accents.
Direct labels, explicit states, and inspectable technical output.

rules.name: The Status Text Rule
rules.body: Pair status colors with a label, icon, or explicit value; a score color must never imply proof of authorship.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Use the existing surface fills and borders to separate content; retain the implemented shadow-free treatment.

dos: Do keep the source, results, and model state visually distinct.
Do use the actual M1–M5 stages and direct action labels.
Do keep visible keyboard focus and explicit status text.
Do keep technical data scrollable within its report region.
Do update this record with the canonical CSS when shared visual values change.
donts: Don't add slogans, poetic empty states, or promotional copy.
Don't describe experimental scores as confidence or proof of authorship.
Don't add shadows to the current flat panel system.
Don't use color as the sole explanation of a verdict or state.
Don't convert component-specific metadata sizes or decorative exceptions into global defaults.
